name: i18n-parity
title_zh: 英法翻译文件对不齐时，逐键比对并修复的校对员
tagline_zh: 当 en.json 和 fr.json 悄悄分家，占位符错位、复数变乱码——它逐键列出差异。
tagline_en: When en.json and fr.json drift apart—wrong placeholders, broken plurals—it diffs every key, surfaces nested.
desc_en: Audit and fix translation files across locales, with a focus on English and French parity. Use when adding or reviewing translations, when locale files drift out of sync, when a placeholder or plural renders wrong, or whenever the user asks about i18n, l10n, localization, translation keys, or pluralization.
why_zh: 不只看缺了哪个键，还检查占位符顺序和复数规则是否一致；修完自动复核，防止你改完一处又弄坏另一处。
why_en: Goes beyond missing-key checks: verifies placeholder order and plural rules match, then re-validates after fixes so you don't.
limit_zh: 只覆盖英文和法文两个 locale 的键级比对；不处理运行时渲染问题，也不管其他语言；需要你本地能跑测试命令。
limit_en: EN↔FR key-level parity only; no runtime rendering checks, no other locales. Requires local test commands and existing translation files.
title_en: Key-by-key auditor that finds and fixes EN-FR translation.
